services.desc: ABC Bicycle and Jet Ski Rentals of Mesa, Arizona, offers jet ski rentals for Mesa and the surrounding areas. We are located in Mesa, Arizona, just 25 minutes from Saguaro Lake and Canyon Lake is only about 40 minutes away. Many of our customers also enjoy Jet Skiing on close by Apache and Roosevelt Lakes. Our personal watercraft is a thrill seeker’s dream. We feature the awesome Yamaha VX110 at unbeatable prices, and since all our staff are water sports enthusiasts, we know what’s needed to make your day on the water perfect!
